# Data dictionary

Schema contract version **1.0.0**. 15 canonical staging tables.

## Conventions

- All timestamps are `timestamptz` in UTC. Dates are calendar dates in UTC.
- All money is in major units (`numeric`), always paired with an ISO 4217 `currency` column, unless the column name ends in `_usd`. Raw minor units are converted in staging.
- Currency codes are upper-case ISO 4217 (`NGN`, never `ngn` or `₦`).
- Identifiers are `text`, unique within their table, and stable across reloads.
- Enum columns use only the listed allowed values. Source values are mapped in staging (CRM via `mappings/crm/*.yml`).
- Test and internal records are kept in staging and flagged downstream, not dropped here.

## Tables

- **CRM:** [`stg_crm__users`](#stg_crm__users), [`stg_crm__accounts`](#stg_crm__accounts), [`stg_crm__contacts`](#stg_crm__contacts), [`stg_crm__leads`](#stg_crm__leads), [`stg_crm__opportunities`](#stg_crm__opportunities), [`stg_crm__opportunity_stage_history`](#stg_crm__opportunity_stage_history)
- **Billing (Stripe-shaped):** [`stg_billing__customers`](#stg_billing__customers), [`stg_billing__subscriptions`](#stg_billing__subscriptions), [`stg_billing__invoices`](#stg_billing__invoices), [`stg_billing__invoice_lines`](#stg_billing__invoice_lines)
- **Ledger:** [`stg_ledger__merchants`](#stg_ledger__merchants), [`stg_ledger__transactions`](#stg_ledger__transactions), [`stg_ledger__disputes`](#stg_ledger__disputes)
- **Rates:** [`stg_rates__fx_rates`](#stg_rates__fx_rates), [`stg_rates__pricing_rates`](#stg_rates__pricing_rates)

## CRM

### stg_crm__users

CRM users who own accounts and opportunities (sales reps and managers).

- **Grain:** one row per CRM user
- **Primary key:** `user_id`

| Column | Type | Nullable | Allowed values | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `user_id` | text | no |  | CRM user identifier. |
| `name` | text | no |  | Display name. |
| `team` | text | yes | `smb`, `mid_market`, `enterprise`, `partnerships` | Sales team the user belongs to. |
| `active` | boolean | no |  | Whether the user is currently active in the CRM. |

### stg_crm__accounts

Companies in the CRM, prospects and customers alike.

- **Grain:** one row per CRM account
- **Primary key:** `account_id`

| Column | Type | Nullable | Allowed values | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account_id` | text | no |  | CRM account identifier. |
| `name` | text | no |  | Company name as entered in the CRM (variants such as "Acme Ltd" vs "ACME Limited" are possible). |
| `domain` | text | yes |  | Lower-case web domain without scheme or `www.`. Used for identity matching. |
| `industry` | text | yes |  | Free-text industry. |
| `country` | text | yes | pattern `^[A-Z]{2}$` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. |
| `segment` | text | yes | `smb`, `mid_market`, `enterprise` | Customer segment. |
| `owner_id` | text | yes |  | CRM user who owns the account. |
| `created_at` | timestamptz | no |  | When the account was created in the CRM. |
| `billing_customer_ref` | text | yes |  | Billing (Stripe) customer id stored on the CRM account, when present. Missing for some won accounts, which are then matched by domain. |

**Foreign keys**

- `owner_id` → [`stg_crm__users`](#stg_crm__users).`user_id`

### stg_crm__leads

Inbound and outbound leads, before and after conversion.

- **Grain:** one row per lead
- **Primary key:** `lead_id`

| Column | Type | Nullable | Allowed values | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lead_id` | text | no |  | CRM lead identifier. |
| `contact_id` | text | yes |  | Contact the lead belongs to. |
| `account_id` | text | yes |  | Account the lead was matched or converted to. |
| `lead_source` | text | yes | `inbound`, `outbound`, `paid`, `partner` | Canonical lead source. Null when the CRM has none. |
| `created_at` | timestamptz | no |  | When the lead was created. |

### stg_crm__opportunities

Sales opportunities (deals).

- **Grain:** one row per opportunity, current state
- **Primary key:** `opportunity_id`

| Column | Type | Nullable | Allowed values | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `opportunity_id` | text | no |  | CRM opportunity identifier. |
| `account_id` | text | no |  | Account the opportunity is for. |
| `owner_id` | text | yes |  | CRM user who owns the opportunity. |
| `amount_usd` | numeric | yes |  | Expected first-year contract value in USD, major units. |
| `created_at` | timestamptz | no |  | When the opportunity was created. |
| `close_date` | date | yes |  | Expected close date when open, actual close date when closed. Can be earlier than created_at in dirty data. |
| `stage` | text | no | `discovery`, `qualified`, `proposal`, `negotiation`, `won`, `lost` | Canonical current stage. |
| `is_closed` | boolean | no |  | True when stage is won or lost. |
| `is_won` | boolean | no |  | True when stage is won. |
| `lead_source` | text | yes | `inbound`, `outbound`, `paid`, `partner` | Canonical lead source of the opportunity. |

**Foreign keys**

- `account_id` → [`stg_crm__accounts`](#stg_crm__accounts).`account_id`
- `owner_id` → [`stg_crm__users`](#stg_crm__users).`user_id`

### stg_crm__opportunity_stage_history

Every stage an opportunity entered, including skips, backward moves and reopens.

- **Grain:** one row per opportunity per stage entry
- **Primary key:** `opportunity_id`, `entered_at`, `stage`
- **Optional:** a source that can't provide this table emits it typed and empty.

| Column | Type | Nullable | Allowed values | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `opportunity_id` | text | no |  | Opportunity whose stage changed. |
| `stage` | text | no | `discovery`, `qualified`, `proposal`, `negotiation`, `won`, `lost` | Canonical stage entered. |
| `entered_at` | timestamptz | no |  | When the opportunity entered the stage. |

**Foreign keys**

- `opportunity_id` → [`stg_crm__opportunities`](#stg_crm__opportunities).`opportunity_id`

## Ledger

### stg_ledger__merchants

Merchants on the payments platform.

- **Grain:** one row per merchant
- **Primary key:** `merchant_id`

| Column | Type | Nullable | Allowed values | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `merchant_id` | text | no |  | Ledger merchant identifier. |
| `billing_customer_id` | text | yes |  | Billing customer linked to the merchant. Null for orphaned merchants. |
| `legal_name` | text | no |  | Registered legal name. |
| `domain` | text | yes |  | Lower-case web domain without scheme or `www.`. |
| `live_at` | timestamptz | yes |  | When the merchant went live. Null if never live. |

### stg_ledger__transactions

Payment transactions processed for merchants.

- **Grain:** one row per transaction
- **Primary key:** `transaction_id`

| Column | Type | Nullable | Allowed values | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `transaction_id` | text | no |  | Ledger transaction identifier. |
| `merchant_id` | text | no |  | Merchant that sent the payment. |
| `created_at` | timestamptz | no |  | When the transaction was created. |
| `status` | text | no | `succeeded`, `failed`, `reversed` | Final transaction status. |
| `rail` | text | no | `swift`, `sepa`, `ach`, `fps`, `nip`, `mpesa` | Payment rail used for the payout leg. |
| `source_currency` | text | no | pattern `^[A-Z]{3}$` | Currency the sender paid in. |
| `dest_currency` | text | no | pattern `^[A-Z]{3}$` | Currency the beneficiary received. |
| `corridor` | text | no | pattern `^[A-Z]{3}-[A-Z]{3}$` | `<source_currency>-<dest_currency>`, e.g. `USD-NGN`. |
| `amount` | numeric | no |  | Transaction amount in `currency`, major units. |
| `currency` | text | no | pattern `^[A-Z]{3}$` | Currency of `amount` (the source currency). |
| `failure_reason` | text | yes | `insufficient_funds`, `compliance_hold`, `beneficiary_bank_reject`, `invalid_account`, `rail_timeout`, `fx_quote_expired` | Why the transaction failed. Null unless status is failed. |

**Foreign keys**

- `merchant_id` → [`stg_ledger__merchants`](#stg_ledger__merchants).`merchant_id`

### stg_ledger__disputes

Disputes and payment returns raised against transactions, typically 30 to 90 days later.

- **Grain:** one row per dispute or return
- **Primary key:** `dispute_id`

| Column | Type | Nullable | Allowed values | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dispute_id` | text | no |  | Ledger dispute identifier. |
| `transaction_id` | text | no |  | Transaction disputed or returned. |
| `dispute_type` | text | no | `dispute`, `return` | `dispute` is raised by the sender; `return` is the beneficiary bank sending funds back. |
| `opened_at` | timestamptz | no |  | When the dispute or return was opened. |
| `resolved_at` | timestamptz | yes |  | When it was resolved. Null while open. |
| `outcome` | text | yes | `won`, `lost` | Resolution from SendFast's side. Null while open. |
| `amount` | numeric | no |  | Amount disputed or returned, major units. |
| `currency` | text | no | pattern `^[A-Z]{3}$` | Currency of `amount`. |

**Foreign keys**

- `transaction_id` → [`stg_ledger__transactions`](#stg_ledger__transactions).`transaction_id`

## Rates

### stg_rates__fx_rates

Daily FX rates. One unit of base_currency equals `rate` units of quote_currency.

- **Grain:** one row per date per currency pair
- **Primary key:** `rate_date`, `base_currency`, `quote_currency`

| Column | Type | Nullable | Allowed values | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rate_date` | date | no |  | Date the rate applies to. |
| `base_currency` | text | no | pattern `^[A-Z]{3}$` | Base currency. |
| `quote_currency` | text | no | pattern `^[A-Z]{3}$` | Quote currency. |
| `rate` | numeric | no |  | Quote units per one base unit. Always positive. |
| `source` | text | no |  | Where the rate came from. |

### stg_rates__pricing_rates

Per-account pricing with effective dates. A renegotiation adds a new row; it never edits an old one.

- **Grain:** one row per account per pricing period
- **Primary key:** `account_ref`, `effective_from`

| Column | Type | Nullable | Allowed values | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account_ref` | text | no |  | CRM account the pricing applies to. |
| `fee_bps` | numeric | no |  | Usage fee in basis points of USD volume. |
| `fx_margin_bps` | numeric | no |  | FX margin in basis points, applied to cross-currency volume. |
| `platform_fee_usd` | numeric | no |  | Monthly platform fee in USD. |
| `min_commit_usd` | numeric | no |  | Monthly minimum revenue commitment in USD; shortfall is billed as a true-up. 0 if none. |
| `effective_from` | date | no |  | First date the pricing applies (inclusive). |
| `effective_to` | date | yes |  | Last date the pricing applies (inclusive). Null while current. |

**Foreign keys**

- `account_ref` → [`stg_crm__accounts`](#stg_crm__accounts).`account_id`
